symptoms: Pediculosis of the eyelashes or eyebrows

management_steps.details: Apply to eyelid margins (cover eyelashes) daily for 10 days.
Do not use white petroleum jelly near eyes. Do not apply directly to eyes.

warnings: Do not use white petroleum jelly near the eyes. Do not apply to eyes.
